note: Resolution giving publicity to the binding report 'con el que se deniega la autorizacion ambiental unificada a Energia, Innovacion y Desarrollo Fotovoltaico, S.A., para el proyecto PSFV Pinar del Rey II, en el termino municipal de Los Barrios (Cadiz) (Expediente: AAU/CA/097/21)'. The operative part ('HA RESUELTO Primero') publishes a refusal of the AAU for the project itself, hence desfavorable. Technology from the project name (PSFV, planta solar fotovoltaica). The document states no capacity, so mw_nominal is labelled null: an extractor that invents a number is scored wrong.
